title: A Quantum Circuit Framework for Protein Ensemble-Level Energetics
summary: Proteins occupy heterogeneous free-energy landscapes in which high-entropy ensembles converge toward compact, low-energy basins with multiple sub-states. Molecular dynamics can access these landscapes at atomic resolution, but exhaustive sampling remains computationally demanding. Meanwhile, most quantum approaches target only single optimal structures, leaving full ensemble energetic heterogeneity unexplored.
